svg.text: Monthly diagram (draw.io SVG + PNG) with per-resource cost and security findings, built from AWS Config, CUR 2.0 and security services; stored in S3 and announced via webhook
AWS Cloud (single account, target regions incl. us-east-1)
Data sources (read-only; unavailable source = status, not failure)
2 Parallel (each branch catches its own failure)
